title: Longest Nondecreasing Run
statement:
Find the longest contiguous stretch whose values never decrease from left to right.

Contract
- `numbers` is non-null and may be empty. Values may be any `int`.
- Return the number of elements in the longest contiguous run where every value is greater than or equal to the previous value.
- Equal neighbouring values may stay in the run. Do not mutate `numbers`.

Examples
- `longestRun(new int[]{5, 6, 6, 2, 3})` returns `3`.
- `longestRun(new int[]{4, 3, 2})` returns `1`.
hints: Track the length of the current run ending at each position.
When the next value is smaller, start a new run at that value.
A single pass with a best-so-far counter is enough; no extra collection is needed.
